thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH latency spike in model-serving (eu-west-1) for requests > 5s. Affected: /v1/generate and chat endpoints. Auto-scaling engaged.
Maria P: seeing the spike in Grafana too. frequency ~2m, tail latency up to 6s. I'm taking initial triage. @eng-oncall-bot can you forward to eu-west oncall? :rotating_light:
eng-oncall-bot: Notifying on-call: Li Z (eu-west). Pager sent via PagerDuty.
Li Z: acknow. joining channel, pulling logs. Maria, can you post sample request IDs?
Maria P: sure — examples: req_6a7f, req_6a8c. paste logs in a sec.
Sam K: FYI — we need customer-facing text for status page and localized notices. This will hit EU customers first; want to prep translations and schedule sends by region to avoid 3am local.
Andrew R: agree. also flagging potential escalation to Dedicated customers if error rate rises. Maria — any ETA on mitigation?
Maria P: I'm rolling a hotfix to reduce tokenization CPU burst (small config). testing on canary now. if green, push in 10m.
Julie Ops: heads-up — we should prepare incident notification windows per region. Last time we sent immediately and woke up APAC customers overnight. Let's be mindful of local business hours.
Sam K: Proposal: publish immediate "investigating" on status page (EN) now, but hold outbound email/SMS notifications to customers in non-Europe regions until their local 08:30-10:30 window. That keeps transparency for EU while minimizing sleep disruptions.
Li Z: +1. here's a quick schedule we can use for automated sends (ops-notify supports timezone targeting):
```
# region -> local send window (local time)
EU: 09:00-10:00 CET/CEST
APAC: 09:30-10:30 JST/AEST
US: 09:00-10:00 PST/EDT
LATAM: 09:00-10:00 BRT
```
Maria P: thanks. can we also attach short localized blurbs for the initial status update so on-call doesn't have to wait for localization? I'll paste templates below. Keep them very short (one sentence) + link to status page details.
Sam K: good idea. use these as the body for email/SMS translations (short):
EN: "We're investigating increased latency for requests to model endpoints in EU. We're working on a fix — updates soon. https://status.redwood.ai"
FR: "Nous enquêtons sur une latence accrue des endpoints modèles en Europe. Nous travaillons sur une résolution — mises à jour à venir. https://status.redwood.ai"
DE: "Wir untersuchen erhöhte Latenz bei Modellendpunkten in Europa. Wir arbeiten an einer Lösung — Updates folgen. https://status.redwood.ai"
ES: "Estamos investigando una mayor latencia en los endpoints de modelos en Europa. Trabajamos en una solución — actualizaciones pronto. https://status.redwood.ai"
JP: "EUリージョンのモデルエンドポイントで遅延が発生しています。修正に取り組んでいます。更新をお待ちください。 https://status.redwood.ai"
Sam K: add a short internal-only note appended to emails for ops contacts: "If you are on-call, escalate via PagerDuty and update this thread."
Julie Ops: also include a caregiver schedule rule: only send push/SMS to APAC between 08:30-10:30 local to limit midnight alerts. We'll implement with ops-notify tags: `region=apac && local_hour in [8..10]`.
Li Z: re: translations — small nit: for JP maybe use "調査中です" vs "修正に取り組んでいます"? I'll ask our i18n volunteer to confirm but either is fine for short blurb.
Maria P: can someone draft the status page "Investigating" entry (short) and an escalation note for Dedicated customers? I can paste once you ACL it.
Andrew R: Draft status page (EN): "Investigating: Elevated latency on model inference in EU (eu-west-1). Root cause under investigation; some requests experiencing >5s latency. Engineers are actively mitigating."
Sam K: add dedicated-customer line: "If you are a Dedicated customer experiencing higher impact, contact your account engineer or open a priority support ticket."
Julie Ops: internal comms template for handoff — paste into thread so next on-call has checklist: 
```
- Incident ID: <incident-id>
- Impact: (regions, endpoints, error/latency) 
- Actions taken: (hotfix/canary/deploy)
- Current status: (mitigating/investigating/resolved)
- Next steps: (who's doing what)
- Pager links + runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/runbook
```
Li Z: ok hotfix canary looks good, rolling to 3 nodes now. monitoring tail latency.
Maria P: can we also queue localized customer emails to send at the region windows above? ops-notify supports scheduling by timezone tag — I can create the job if we agree on copy.
Sam K: please do. use short EN + localized blurbs we pasted. include an explicit instruction in email header for customers in EU: "We will update you as we progress." For other regions, subject prefix with [Incident - update scheduled local morning].
Andrew R: I'm cc'ing account managers for Dedicated customers (posting in parallel channel). Julie — coordinate targeted outreach for top 10 accounts after we confirm mitigation.
Julie Ops: will do. I’ll prepare the targeted message template and cc list.
eng-oncall-bot: Reminder — handoff at 08:00 UTC. Li Z to hand off to Sam K in 2 hours if still open.
Li Z: noted. if hotfix holds and metrics improve we'll mark 'monitoring' and schedule a follow-up update in 1h.
Maria P: metrics improving on canary (p95 down from 5.9s -> 1.2s). starting gradual rollout.
Sam K: Great. I'll update status page to "Identified" and schedule localized sends per windows. Draft for status page (EN): "Identified: A tokenization CPU issue caused elevated inference latency in eu-west-1. A rolling fix is being deployed and metrics are improving. Customers may see intermittent latency. Further updates in 30m."
Maria P: rolling completed. Monitoring shows stable latency.
eng-oncall-bot: Incident status: Monitoring. Incident closed by Maria P at 1750008799.
Julie Ops: After-action items: 1) Add timezone-aware send presets to incident playbook. 2) Add JP translation review to i18n rotation. 3) Run a tabletop on regional notify rules. I'll create tickets. :white_check_mark:
Sam K: thanks everyone. putting follow-up items into the postmortem.
Maria P: thanks team. closing thread. :slightly_smiling_face:
